case.summary: The evidence shows an online card-not-present purchase that the customer says they did not make, and the transaction is consistent with prior confirmed card-not-present fraud on this card. The device was previously seen on the account and there was no proxy, so this is not the stronger new-device variant, but the transaction still has multiple fraud-leaning signals including all unnamed match flags being true and no distance value. Legitimate indicators are present too, including prior use of this device 9 time(s) before and an amount that is within the card's historical range, so the evidence supports card-not-present fraud rather than a card-testing or account-takeover pattern.
